x-m-h2-01.title: Thola umugqa lapho isixazululo sesibalo se-logarithmic sinenkinga
x-m-h2-01.goal: Thola futhi ulungise inkinga ebangelwa ukungahloli isimo se-argument esixazululweni sesibalo se-logarithmic.
x-m-h2-01.material: U-Minho uxazulule isibalo log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 wathi, ‘Izixazululo ngu-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbili.’ Uma kufundwa phezulu, kuthiwa ‘log base 2 ka-(x ukhipha 1) kwengeziwe log base 2 ka-(x ukhipha 3) kulingana no-3’.
x-m-h2-01.thinking.2: Lungisa impendulo bese uchaza ukuthi kungani
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa osixazululweni sika-Minho onenkinga. (Uma imigqa eminingana elandelanayo inenkinga, ungakhetha owodwa kuphela.)
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma isibalo sishintsha, funda ngenkathi uhlola ukuthi sisho into efanayo nomugqa ongaphambilini.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amanani asekugcineni kwesixazululo ngqo esibalweni somugqa wokuqala. Kwenzekani enanini elingaphakathi kwe-logarithm?
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.explain: Indawo yokuqala lapho kuphutha khona ngumugqa 2. Uma isamba sama-logarithm amabili sihlanganiswa sibe i-logarithm eyodwa, izimo ze-argument x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala esibalweni, futhi lezo zimo azibhalwanga ngokwehlukana. Ngakho emugqeni 5 zombili izimpande zamukelwe, futhi umugqa 6 yisiphetho salokho. I-argument kufanele ibe nhle, ngakho x>3 iyadingeka. Uma x=−1, khona-ke x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, ama-argument angekho kahle, ngakho isibalo asichazwanga. Uma x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngakho siyasebenza. Ngakho isixazululo siyinani elilodwa x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.prompt: Tshela u-Minho isixazululo esilungile nesizathu. Faka nokuthi yiyiphi inkinga eyenzeka uma ufaka x=−1 esibalweni sokuqala.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funda ngenkathi uhlola isizathu sokuthi isibalo sishintshwe kanjani emugqeni ngamunye.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka x=−1 no-x=5 ngakunye kuma-argument ama-logarithm esibalweni sokuqala bese uhlola ukuthi amanani aba yini.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi kungani x=−1 ingeke ibe yisixazululo usebenzisa inani le-argument?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi yisiphi isimo esidingekayo ngaphambi kokuthi isibalo sishintshwe?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ufake x=5 esibalweni sokuqala ukuhlola ukuthi siyasigculisa?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.0: Isixazululo esisodwa kuphela ngu-x=5. Uma ngifaka x=−1, i-argument ayinhle njenge-log₂(−2), ngakho ayichazwanga. Ngakho u-5 kuphela, ogculisa isimo se-argument x>3, uyisixazululo.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.1: Uma uxazulula isibalo, ama-argument kufanele ahlale enhle. x−1>0 no-x−3>0, ngakho x>3 iyadingeka, futhi x=−1 ayiphakathi kwaleli banga, ngakho kufanele ilahlwe. Ngakho impendulo ngu-x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.2: Kusuka ezimweni ze-argument x−1>0 no-x−3>0, x>3. x=−1 ingaphandle kwebanga, ngakho yilahle, futhi impendulo ngu-5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.3: Impendulo ngu-5. Ukufaka x=−1 kunika log₂(−2), okungachazwanga, ngakho akuyona isixazululo.

x-m-h2-07.title: Ingabe u-∞−∞ ulingana no-0? Ukuhlola izimangalo zabangani ababili
x-m-h2-07.goal: Hlola izimangalo ezimbili ngokubala kwezinombolo, chaza lapho ukucabanga komqondo kwaphutha khona, bese uthola umkhawulo usebenzisa i-algebra.
x-m-h2-07.material: UMinsu wathi, 'Njengoba u-x eba mkhulu ngokungapheli, √(x²+x) usondela ku-x, ngakho √(x²+x) − x usondela ku-0.' USeoa wathi, 'Awusondeli ku-0, usondela enombolweni ethile ephozithivu.' Indlela yokufunda: √(x²+x) yimpande yesikwele ye-x owenziwe isikwele kanye no-x, futhi 'x eba mkhulu ngokungapheli' ngu-x→∞.
x-m-h2-07.prereq.0: Incazelo yomkhawulo uma u-x eba mkhulu ngokungapheli
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.prompt: Ungasebenzisa ikhalkhuletha. Khetha izinombolo ezigcwele ezintathu u-x okungenani ezingu-100, bala inani lika-√(x²+x) − x, uliqoqe libe yindawo yedesimali yesithathu, bese ulifaka njengo-(x, inani). Ukufaka u-x amathathu ahlukile kuyaqeda. (Uma isimangalo sikaMinsu silungile, leli nani kufanele lisondele ku-0 uma u-x emkhulu.)
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-x=100 no-x=1000 ku-√(x²+x)−x bese ubala.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza u-x abe mkhulu nakakhulu bese ubheka ukuthi inani lihamba ngasiphi isiqondiso.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c1: U-x kufanele abe yinombolo egcwele engu-100 okungenani.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c2: Inani olifake lihambisana nomphumela obalwe ka-√(x²+x)−x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c2: Inani olifake lihlukile emphumeleni obaliwe. Phinda ubale u-√(x²+x)−x ngekhalkhuletha futhi uzungeze kuze kube ngamadesimali amathathu.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.explain: Ku-x=100 kungu-0.4988 cishe, ku-x=1000 u-0.49988 cishe, futhi ku-x=10000 u-0.49999 cishe. Noma wenza u-x abe mkhulu, akusondeli ku-0 futhi kuhlala eduze no-0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.prompt: Ukubheka imiphumela yokubala, siphi isitatimende sikaMinsu noSeoa esisekelwa kangcono? Khetha incazelo evumelekile kakhulu.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Beka amanani abaliwe ngamanani amathathu ka-x eceleni komunye nomunye bese ubona ukuthi inani lishintsha kanjani njengoba u-x eba mkhulu.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa ukuthi u-'sondela' ukhuluma ngesilinganiso noma ngomehluko.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.a: Isitatimende sikaSeoa siyasekelwa. Umehluko uqoqana eduze kwenani elingelona u-0
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.a: Noma u-x wenziwe waba mkhulu, inani alishintshanga eduze no-0.5, ngakho kungubufakazi obuphikisana nesisho sokuthi ungu-0.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.b: UMinsu uyiso. Isilinganiso sisondela ku-1, ngakho umehluko usondela ku-0 nawo
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.b: Isilinganiso ukusondela ku-1 akusho ukuthi umehluko usondela ku-0. Isibonelo, isilinganiso sika-x no-x+0.5 sisondela ku-1, kodwa umehluko uhlala ungu-0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.c: UMinsu uyiso. Inani eliphezulu kuno-0 yiphutha lekhalkhuletha
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.c: Uma ushintsha u-x futhi amanani eqoqana eduze kwenani elifanayo (eduze no-0.5), kunzima ukulithatha njengephutha.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.d: Awukwazi ukusho noma yikuphi. Ukubala akukutsheli lutho
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.d: Izinombolo azifakazeli umkhawulo, kodwa ziyubufakazi obuphikisana nesisho sika-'0'.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.explain: Amanani abaliwe aqoqana eduze no-0.5 noma u-x eba mkhulu, ngakho isitatimende sikaSeoa siyasekelwa. Kodwa izinombolo ziyubufakazi nje, futhi ukuze uhlole ngqo ukuthi inani liyini, udinga ukuguqula inkulumo.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani ukucabanga kukaMinsu 'u-√(x²+x) usondela ku-x, ngakho umehluko ungu-0' kuphosile, bese uthola inani lomkhawulo ngokuguqula inkulumo.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi inombolo engaphezulu iba yini uma uphindaphinda futhi uhlukanisa u-√(x²+x)−x ngo-√(x²+x)+x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.1: Hlukanisa inombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi ngo-x, bese ubona ukuthi ingxenye ngayinye isondela kunani liphi uma u-x eba mkhulu ngokungapheli.

x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ukuguqulwa owakwenzile kuguqule inkulumo yaba yifomu lapho umkhawulo ungatholwa khona?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Inani olibonile ngokubala (0.4999…) nomkhawulo owuthole kuyahambisana?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.0: Ukusondela ku-x kusho ukuthi isilinganiso sisondela ku-1, hhayi ukuthi umehluko uba ngu-0. Ukwenza inombolo engaphezulu ibe yi-rational kunika u-x/(√(x²+x)+x)=1/(√(1+1/x)+1), futhi uma x→∞ kungu-1/2.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.1: Noma u-√(x²+x) ebukeka efana no-x, kusenomehluko phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili, ngakho akumele ngiyiguqule ibe ngu-x−x=0. Ukuphindaphinda inombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi nge-conjugate u-√(x²+x)+x kunika u-x/(√(x²+x)+x), futhi umkhawulo ungu-0.5 (=1/2).
